1. Longer test beds are available. Use of optional linear guide covers reduces available test opening.
2. Contact Instron for lower backlash requirements.
3. Includes clearance above and behind the frame to open guard door and includes feet height of 32 mm (1.25 in). Does not include
 clearance to mount optional axial preload assembly (requires clearance of 230 mm (9 in) on each side of frame).
4. Does not include weight of any fixtures or optional accessories that can be mounted on the frame.
5. Weight supplied is 4.54 kgs (10 lbs). Actual tension or compression load on the specimen does not correspond to the weight used due
 to linear guide and pulley friction. Custom device available.
